extraction.experiment: Sweeping the driving frequency ω shows the steady-state amplitude A of Eq. 15.29 peaking at the natural frequency ω_0. Raising the damping b lowers and widens that peak, which is the document's resonance claim (Figure 15.31).
extraction.reproduce: Driving at the natural frequency with light damping gives the maximum amplitude F_0/(bω_0) = 10 for m = k = 1, b = 0.1.
extraction.contrast: Tripling the damping at the same resonant drive gives a much lower peak and a much wider resonance curve.
